description: Introduces apply_bulk_discount for large orders that scales the discount by a bulk factor. Developed over 4 small commits.
author: jsmith

title: Fix rounding to always round half up
description: Standardizes currency rounding. The feature commit is clean; the merge commit is where things go wrong.
author: avarma

-    """Round amount to 2 decimal places using standard rounding."""

+    return float(Decimal(str(amount)).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
